description: Narrow the 'Configuration change' setup-checklist cue so it stops firing on incidental prose mentions of config/configuration.

userStories.title: Require a change/setup context for the Configuration change cue
userStories.description: As an operator reading a generated PR body, I need the 'Configuration change' setup-checklist row to appear only when the PRD describes a genuine configuration change (not any passing mention of the word 'config'/'configuration') so that the setup checklist stays high-signal.
acceptanceCriteria: The 6th/last SETUP_CHECKLIST_CUES entry in src/release/pr-body.ts keeps item 'Configuration change' and its { pattern, item, where, how } shape, but its pattern now requires config/configuration to co-occur with a change/setup signal (an action verb such as new/update/change/edit/add/set, or a config-artifact token such as project.toml or a config file) instead of matching a bare standalone word. [oracle: file-assert grep -q "item: 'Configuration change'" src/release/pr-body.ts]
The config cue remains the LAST entry in SETUP_CHECKLIST_CUES (no reorder) and no other cue's pattern, item, where, or how is modified. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

A NEW negative test in test/release/pr-body.test.ts asserts the rendered PR body does NOT contain 'Configuration change' for input that mentions config only incidentally (e.g. description 'the configuration option is already documented' or 'no configuration changes are required'), placing the cue text in prd.description/prd.notes or a story title since renderSetupChecklist only scans [prd.description, prd.notes, ...story.title]. [oracle: bun test test/release/pr-body.test.ts]

A NEW positive test in test/release/pr-body.test.ts asserts the rendered PR body DOES contain 'Configuration change' for input describing a genuine change (e.g. 'add a new key to project.toml' or 'update the configuration value in project.toml'). [oracle: bun test test/release/pr-body.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test), including all pre-existing pr-body tests. [oracle: bun test]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Single file: src/release/pr-body.ts (SETUP_CHECKLIST_CUES ~line 61-98, config cue at line 93) + test/release/pr-body.test.ts. renderSetupChecklist (~line 141-144) uses SETUP_CHECKLIST_CUES.filter(cue => cue.pattern.test(haystack)) where haystack = [prd.description ?? '', prd.notes ?? '', ...story.title].join('\n'); story descriptions/bodies are NOT scanned, so put test cue text in description/notes/title. Gotchas from the issue spec: (a) .filter is every-match (not first-match-wins), so narrowing must not accidentally match another cue's row; (b) 'configurable'/'reconfigure' already don't match the current \bconfig(?:uration)?\b boundary, so the false-positive class is genuine STANDALONE config/configuration prose words; (c) existing tests assert via body.toContain(...) substring, not exact row-label equality, and there is currently NO test exercising the config cue specifically ('detects a config/install/migration cue from a story title alone' actually asserts 'Database migration' via the migration cue). Curated invariant: noUncheckedIndexedAccess makes regex capture-group access T|undefined, guard any capture-group read with ?? fallback. Keep the file Bun-first.
